messages.content: The Staybridge confirmation has the correct September 11-13 dates and my name, but it does not show the late-arrival note. It also lists parking as a separate daily charge. The quoted $537.76 looked complete. I can cancel for two more days.

Since you will not have a vehicle, parking should not increase the approved total. The expected charges should remain $478 room plus $59.76 tax, totaling $537.76. The separate parking disclosure is harmless only if it is conditional rather than already included in the reservation balance.
What exactly should I ask them to correct before the cancellation window closes?

Ask the hotel to add a late-arrival note for arrival after 8:00 p.m. and confirm that the room remains guaranteed. Also ask for a revised confirmation showing no parking charge attached to your booking and a total of $537.76, with the $478 room and $59.76 tax breakdown. If parking is merely listed as an optional property fee, request written confirmation that it will not apply because you will not have a car. Keep that reply with the booking record before the free-cancellation deadline.
